name: Ultimate Slot of America

features.name: Freedom Respins
features.description: Each new gem keeps the respin chain going.

features.name: Gem Clusters
features.description: Square groups of four or more gems merge into larger symbols.

review:
Ultimate Slot of America is a patriotic, over-the-top slot built around Liberty Gems, wild multipliers worth 1x to 10x. Each landing gem triggers a Freedom Respin with all gems holding in place, and the respins continue as long as new gems keep landing, paying out at every step.

Four or more gems in a square form a Gem Cluster, which merges them into one larger symbol. Several gems in the same win add their values together. It's a very readable game with a rhythm you can follow, and the 10,000x maximum is available throughout.
